data.title: 鸣濑白羽 · 老屋榻榻米上的初次袒露
data.description: 海风吹拂着老旧和室的风铃。白羽咬着自己的银白发丝侧躺在席上，单薄的纯白睡衣被推至腰际，纤弱的锁骨与腹部剧烈起伏，任由灼热的手掌寸寸探索。
data.location: traditional seaside Japanese tatami room with open sliding doors to evening garden
data.action: lying on side on woven tatami mats, white nightgown rolled up to bare slender stomach, biting her white hair lock in dizzying breathless passion
data.lighting: soft moonlight filtering through bamboo blinds mixed with faint wind chime tinkling
data.mood: tender island passion, bashful trembling vulnerability, complete romantic surrender
data.promptProse: Reclining on tatami in a lifted white sleep camisole, Shiroha bites a strand of her silver hair, eyes shining with bashful overwhelming lust.
data.animaCaption: Shiroha lying on tatami in lifted sleepwear, biting her hair in bashful ecstasy.
